comment: The envelope and the VCA are independent: processVca() reads only CV In and the VOL knob, never env (TL_Shape.cpp:166-196). The maker's summary calls the module "ADSR + VCA" without saying the two are not joined internally, which is the thing most likely to make it look broken. The gate test is a level compare at 1V rather than a Schmitt trigger, and the panel TRIG button is a gate rather than a trigger: it holds the envelope at sustain while held. The release always falls from whatever level the envelope had reached, over the full release time. Times run from 1ms to 10 seconds (knobToTime at TL_Shape.cpp:94); the maker gives no figures. Every jack is read with getVoltage(), so nothing is polyphonic.
